name: Thomas Wolf
bio: Thomas Wolf is a co-founder and the Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face. Trained in physics, with a PhD in statistical and quantum physics, he moved into machine learning around 2015 and has worked on open-source libraries and open-science projects such as BigScience. He co-authored the book Natural Language Processing with Transformers.
known_for: Co-creating the Transformers and Datasets libraries
BigScience, BLOOM, and FineWeb open-science work
Co-authoring Natural Language Processing with Transformers
